khai.tagline: Scarcity as process: how the felt lack of a resource captures the mind -- focusing it on the shortfall while taxing the capacity to think and plan -- across the tunneling, bandwidth, and trap forms.

card.wire: Attaches at Process. The root (process_scarcity.md) declares scarcity as the psychology of having less than one feels one needs: the felt lack of a resource -- money, time, food, company -- capturing the mind and reorganizing it around the shortfall. The law makes the subjective sense of not-enough a force that both sharpens attention on the lack and taxes the mental capacity left for everything else, so that scarcity is not merely a state of the world but a state of the mind it produces.
card.issue: Three ways the lack takes hold. Tunneling: the shortfall seizes attention, focusing the persona so hard on the pressing lack that a focus dividend is won inside the tunnel and everything outside it -- the important but not urgent -- is neglected. Bandwidth: the lack loads the mind, the nagging of the shortfall consuming cognitive capacity and self-control so that fluid intelligence and executive function measurably fall while one is short. Trap: the neglect and the tax compound, the persona borrowing against the future to meet the present lack and so deepening the future's, a self-perpetuating spiral that keeps the scarce scarce.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. The link: each persona links, under Projection, the form the moment runs -- and therefore how the felt lack is working on them, by narrowing them into the tunnel, by taxing their bandwidth, or by trapping them in the spiral.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared and each persona links a real form of scarcity. Whether the capture is true to the scene -- a genuine felt lack genuinely reorganizing the mind, the tunneling or the bandwidth or the trap read right, the shortfall doing the work -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give the persona its form under Projection. Read it as the felt lack of a resource capturing and taxing the mind -- the tunnel narrowing onto the shortfall, the bandwidth spent on the nagging lack, the spiral of borrowing against the future -- never as mere poverty of the world nor as a trait of the person. Delegate the resource itself to the money and capital engines, the capacity that is taxed to the executive-function and attention engines, and the demand-exceeds-resources strain to the stress engine.
